Count a Java process as the Spark JVM only when it runs Spark

test_measure_runs_the_pandas_pipeline_in_fresh_processes failed
intermittently (1 in 20 runs) when measure's sampler, every 0.25 s,
caught the java -version that the pipelines start for their run record
and counted it as the Spark JVM. src/etf_risk/measure.py now counts a
Java process as spark_jvm only if its command line runs Spark
(org.apache.spark, as the SparkSubmit JVM that PySpark starts does);
java -version and the other helpers (git, uname, file) count as other.
Every new run and protocol record carries the rule in a process_kinds
field. Earlier records, which counted every process named java as
spark_jvm, and the committed measurement CSVs are unchanged; the spec,
the demo and the measurements README document both rules. One sampling
step is split out as TreeSampler.sample(), with the same logic.

Tests: deterministic ones in tests/test_measure.py classify stand-in
processes, including a sample taken while java -version runs, and the
test session's real Spark JVM. tests/test_pandas_pipeline.py accepts
helpers as other while still failing on spark_jvm or python_worker, and
checks that measure records the Spark JVM of a Spark pipeline run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
